name: Braveheart Bio, Inc.
summary: Braveheart Bio, Inc. a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing therapies for patients with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) and other serious cardiovascular diseases. It develops and offers BHB-1893 and HRS-1893, an oral small-molecule cardiac myosin inhibitor (CMI) for the treatment of obstructive HCM and non-obstructive HCM. The company was incorporated in 2024 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
